pickupcard.config.style.tooltip: CARD = full card; MINIMAL = icon and count only.
pickupcard.config.showItemName.tooltip: Off keeps only the icon and count.
pickupcard.config.enterMs.tooltip: Fade-in duration in ms. 260-320 feels best.
pickupcard.config.holdMs.tooltip: How long a card stays on screen.
pickupcard.config.enterTilt.tooltip: How tilted a card is on entry, in degrees.
pickupcard.config.pulseEnabled.tooltip: Briefly pop when the same item is picked again.
pickupcard.config.mergeEnabled.tooltip: Merge repeat pickups of the same item.
pickupcard.config.mergeWindowMs.tooltip: How long counts as the same pickup.
pickupcard.config.anchor.tooltip: Which corner the cards attach to.
pickupcard.config.growth.tooltip: NATURAL keeps the newest at the anchor.
pickupcard.config.queueSize.tooltip: Pickups waiting for a free slot.
pickupcard.config.showSheen.tooltip: Enchanted items get a purple glint.
pickupcard.config.raritySkins.tooltip: Each rarity gets its own card skin; off = every tier uses the common wooden card.
pickupcard.config.showNewBadge.tooltip: Shown the first time you grab an item.
pickupcard.config.title: Pickup Card Settings
pickupcard.config.animationStyle.tooltip: One choice drives enter, settle, exit and pulse. CLEAN, SOFT, SPRINGY (default), BOUNCY.
pickupcard.config.nameColor.tooltip: Name colour for common items; rarer items override it.
pickupcard.config.accentColor.tooltip: Count readout and NEW tag. Format #AARRGGBB.
pickupcard.config.nameMaxWidth.tooltip: In pixels; longer names get an ellipsis. 0 = unlimited.
pickupcard.config.showItemId.tooltip: Print minecraft:gold_ingot instead of the name.
